title: Bonnybridge UFO hotspot and stepfather's sightings

tellings.quote: he used to live in Faluk which is near Bonnybridge which is in Scotland and it's like a Scottish UFO hotspot. Had many many sightings almost like a tourist attraction. You know people go there to see UFOs

plain: Bonnybridge, a place in Scotland near the town of Falkirk, is described as a Scottish UFO hotspot with so many sightings that it is "almost like a tourist attraction," where people go to see UFOs. The computer hacker Gary McKinnon tells this as something passed on by his stepfather, who lived near Bonnybridge and had sightings of his own there.
